newsitem.title: HAITI: Chilean diplomat's adopted son arrested for murder.
newsitem.headline: Chilean diplomat's adopted son arrested for murder.

text.p: Police said on Thursday they had arrested the adopted son of a Chilean diplomat who was killed last month near Port-au-Prince.

Theofilo Pezerro, a 30-year-old Brazilian, was arrested on Wednesday on suspicion of murdering 58-year-old Eduardo Vega, whose burned and mutilated body was found in a car on Feb. 18 in the Port-au-Prince suburb of Tabarre.
Chilean diplomats said they would seek dilpomatic immunity for Pezerro, who was adopted recently by Vega, according to the Haitian Press Agency.
Chilean Ambassador Louis Goycolea declined to comment to Reuters about the relationship between the two men. "We're just trying to find out what happened," Goycolea said.
